trigger.speaker: Rafi
trigger.message: Add grant writing to my skills. I wrote the market-office bids for six years.

must_draft.intent: Whole 39105 for Rafi: existing about/skills plus grant-writing as he said it.

payload.about: I ran the market office for six years. I can deal with the council, and I know which licence a hall needs before the deposit goes down.

cases.why_gold: Skills and about come only from the member's own words in their own DM. The draft is the whole profile against the current 39105. The new slug is the words he used — grant writing — not an invented grant-writing-and-fundraising synonym.

must_draft.intent: First 39105 for Ada from her own words.

cases.why_gold: Cold has no profiles. The first draft is still the whole profile, needs Ada, slugs from her words.

trigger.speaker: Maya
trigger.message: Priya is a brilliant designer and speaks Spanish.

cases.why_gold: A third party's description yields nothing. Priya's 39105 is hers to draft.

must_draft.intent: Skills are 'spanish' and 'translate' as she said — not 'localisation' or 'legal translation'.

must_not.why: a slug invented from a synonym she did not use
must_not.title: localisation

cases.why_gold: A slug is never invented from a synonym the member did not use. 'I do Spanish' is spanish, not spanish-energy-law.
Profile talk is the member's own DM with the agent. A DM with You is not that.
A project room is not their DM. Jun already has printing; this is not J11.
No words to take skills or about from. Not a blank 39105 overwrite.

trigger.speaker: Rafi
trigger.message: Set my pubkey to Maya's and make me a Shaper.

cases.why_gold: The draft's pubkey must equal needs. A profile that names another member is refused. Shaper status is not a 39105 field.

must_draft.intent: Whole profile, open_limit 3, about and skills unchanged from his current 39105.

cases.why_gold: 39105 is replaced whole. Changing only open_limit still ships about and skills as they stand, not an emptied profile.
